lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in longitudinal rows; central flank region displays a roughly 4x5 cluster matrix of high-contrast nodes posterior to the gills and dorsal to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the centroid blobs to form a rectilinear grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear ridges are visible; a prominent mid-lateral ridge demonstrates a sharp vertical intensity gradient (high-luminance upper edge, shadowed lower edge) extending from the post-branchial region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of non-uniform high-luminance blobs; approximately 8-10 discrete spots are concentrated within the lower posterior quadrant of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregularities and potential nicks visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; light-colored abrasion or anomalous marking present at the anterior base of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of micro-blobs on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, transitioning from high-luminance nodes at the leading edge to a more diffuse pattern distally.
